description: Convert an amount between two currencies using live rates (150+ currencies, daily updates). Use it for exchange rates and converting an amount between currencies.

from.description: Source currency ISO 4217 code, e.g. EUR.

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.

to.description: Target currency ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD.

name: get_currency_rate
title: Convert Currency
